parameters.query: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(), '%Y-%m-%d') AS fecha, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Ventas_Diarias WHERE Fecha = CURRENT_DATE()) AS cierres, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Compras_Proveedores WHERE Fecha = CURRENT_DATE()) AS facturas, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Gasto_operacional WHERE Fecha = CURRENT_DATE()) AS gastos, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Flujo_Pan WHERE Fecha = CURRENT_DATE()) AS control_pan;
